segments.an10.171:1.1: [a. ni.10.113]“Adhammo ca, bhikkhave, veditabbo anattho ca;
segments.an10.171:1.3: Adhammañca viditvā anatthañca, dhammañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
segments.an10.171:2.1: “Katamo ca, bhikkhave, adhammo ca anattho ca?
segments.an10.171:2.2: Pāṇātipāto, adinnādānaṃ, kāmesumicchācāro, musāvādo, pisuṇā vācā, pharusā vācā, samphappalāpo, abhijjhā, byāpādo, micchādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, adhammo ca anattho ca.
segments.an10.171:3.1: “Katamo ca, bhikkhave, dhammo ca attho ca?
segments.an10.171:3.2: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī, musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī, anabhijjhā, abyāpādo, sammādiṭṭhi – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dhammo ca attho ca.
segments.an10.171:4.3: Adhammañca viditvā anatthañca, dhammañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabban’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttan”ti.
